title: Chapter 595
paragraphs: Chapter 595
155. Back to Lafralarosa (3)
Rosa Runcandel's time ends in 3 years.
Whether it would be death, turning into a monster like Smarion Proch, or some other form of something, it was unclear.
There is a slim chance, but if she could overcome the 'demonic transformation', she might be able to reach the creation like Lon.
However, Jin decided to exclude the case of Rosa ascending to creation.
Because not anyone else, but Rosa used the expression 'she might be able to endure'. Jin thought that it was impossible for Rosa to completely eliminate the demonic transformation with her own power.
Even Siron, who has already reached creation, realizes that his remaining time is not long. Rosa knew his condition better than anyone.
"Rather, what you should worry about is not me, but Gipul's recovery. Kellyak Gipul, he is currently unable to move... but probably he will recover faster than me."
Rosa was not the only one in the family who fell into demonic transformation.
The surviving Black Knights and elite knights from the war were also exposed to big and small chaos. The same was true for Gipul.
"Even if they recover their strength at any time, they cannot move rashly within the agreement period."

"I guess so. However, there's no way you don't know that it doesn't mean anything. When the armistice ends, if they have an overwhelming power over us. That day will be the beginning of the destruction."
The official armistice period was 5 years.
The masses hope the armistice to be forever, but both major families knew that it was the last rest of the long thousand-year war, the eve of the storm.
At the end of the armistice, a final winner and loser will definitely be determined.
"So this is your last chance. Use all possible means to prove that you were right. If you succeed, you will have everything in the family."
'If you stop their demonic transformation, complete the mechanical devices and fleets, and provide confidence to lead the thousand-year war to victory.'
You will become the family head. Rosa was saying that.
Jin had come to the last journey to ascend to the throne of Runcandel. However, feeling a bit strange, Jin didn't believe Rosa's words exactly.
"Youngest."
"Please speak."
"The prophet said he can execute everything you're trying to do right now. Still, the reason why I'm giving you an opportunity is because Siron trusts you... and because you have somewhat moved me."
"I didn't know the day would come when I would hear a joke from my mother. I'm not unaware that you are just weighing between me and the prophet."
At Jin's lively voice, Rosa smiled.
"I hope that scale tilts towards you."
"You, the prophet, and Joshua Runcandel, the former 2nd generation who is locked up in the underground dungeon."
Jin, who had turned around, paused for a moment.
"I will definitely end it with my own hands, so I wish you well until then."
"Such praiseworthy words. It seems the conversation is over, so let's go out."
Jin naturally followed Rosa out of the office.
Upon reflection, it seemed like this was the first time he was walking side by side with Rosa in the Garden of Swords.
Even more surprising, Rosa was walking briskly, like someone who had just received good news.
It was also his first time seeing Rosa like this.
"Order all waiting family members to gather in the garden."
She didn't call anyone specifically, nor did she raise her voice. Yet, Rosa's command spread in an instant.
Despite her not being in the best condition, she still commanded an air of dignity.
It took less than three minutes for all the knights, elders, housekeepers, and servants to gather in the garden.
Rosa stopped walking, and Jin looked down at the gathered family members with her for a while.
"From today, the 12th generation will begin secluded training. I have gathered you all to announce this, so I hope everyone will wish him luck."
Despite the precarious state of the family, and everyone's busy day-to-day life, they were announcing secluded training.
Most were shocked, but no one dared to show it.
Because Rosa had acknowledged it.
"When the 12th generation returns, everyone here should show improvement from their current state, just as the 12th generation has always done."
In effect, Rosa's actions were no different from declaring that the competition for rank among the current generation was over.
It was as if she was saying that Jin would immediately become the head of the family once he finishes his training.
Luna, Runtia, Joshua. All the members of the generation were present except for these three.
'The youngest... becoming the head?'
'After secluded training?'
The Tona brothers barely managed to hide their shock.
Ran and Vugo blinked in surprise, but quickly lowered their eyes. They had never been actively involved in the competition for the headship in the first place.
Mew and An did not react differently. Everyone in the family knew that they had changed.
However, Diphus and Mary, like Jin in the office, were convinced that this was not the end.
Especially Diphus, who recalled the conversation he had with Jin right after Joshua's downfall.
-So you're saying, our mother plans to control the Prophet, turn everything around on him later, and restore Joshua?

-Not only that, by causing Joshua's downfall, she has re-established your authority. Any blemishes from the Exile Incident will likely disappear because of this. She showed her strength by personally defeating the second generation, who she had supported so much. Regardless of the inside story, the family members will be more afraid of Mother from now on.
-After enhancing your power to its limit, she will bring Joshua back to the surface and transfer all power to him... The Prophet will bear all the sins and blame.
'The competition for rank won't end until Mother, Joshua, and the Prophet are dead.'
Mu and Ann had formed some kind of relationship with the Prophet. Defus and Mary suspected this, although they had not yet found proof.
Their task was to keep the Prophet in check until Jin returned.
One of the reasons Jin could leave like this was his faith in them and Runtia.
Runtia's relationship with them was not clearly friendly, but her pure fighting spirit would not easily be tainted by the Prophet's schemes.
"Go."
At Rosa's command, the knights split to either side, forming a path that led out of the Sword Garden.
The first trip to Lafrarosa in 1796, when he was a trainee knight, was a choice to avoid Zifel and Kinzel who had a compass.
The second trip to Lafrarosa in 1798 was to hide from the bounty orders of Runkandel and Zifel.
And now, the third trip to Lafrarosa.
For the first time, he was leaving not as a fugitive, but to achieve a complete accomplishment, with the blessings of the entire family.
As Jin slowly moved, the knights raised their swords in salute as he passed.
Watching her youngest son's figure receding into the distance, Rosa thought about the name 'Ganesto', the fate of the family, and Ciron.
Not long after the Sword Emperor's ceremony ended, Ciron's expedition decided on a duel with Kiar.
The battle ended in a victory for the expedition, with no deaths.
Although the expedition's power was transcendent, Ciron originally expected to lose a few knights.
At the height of the battle, Glick's death had an effect on Kiar.
The moment Kiar realized Glick's demise, he lost his sanity in a frenzy.
Of course, while there were no deaths, the damage sustained by the expedition was far from minor.
A month had passed since the end of the battle, but the expedition was still unable to move forward and was recuperating.
All were exposed to chaos.
[Ha, hahaha. Sir! The meal is ready... If everyone takes a seat, I, Ozzdock, will bring it to you!]
Ozzdock said, filling dishes with food made from the remnants of chaos.
Even Ozzdock, who had been unconscious far away on the battlefield, had a faint tinge of chaos. However, it was still not enough to affect his mind.
In other words, he was the only one in the expedition who was completely fine.
The knights discovered an unexpected side of him. When the knights were nearly dead after the battle, Ozzdock could have escaped at any time.
Ozzdock did not flee at that time but stayed to help the knights recover.
He didn't do this because he thought he would certainly meet a cruel death at the hands of Ciron upon the completion of the expedition if he ran away.
He simply felt a sense of duty as a member of the expedition and made the decision because he thought it was the right thing to do. The knights were not unaware of this fact.
"Thank you... Ozzdock."
"We appreciate it."
Luna and the knights' voices made Ozdok feel a lump in his throat.
On the other hand, it was painful. Except for not dying, he knew that most of the knights had already been exposed to chaos to the point of no return.
The future given to them was nothing but turning into monsters during the expedition or facing death.
As the power of the story weakened, Ozdok also recovered more of his old memories.
According to the faintly emerging memories, only the witch Heluram had a way to eradicate chaos.

'I think I heard a story that Heluram hid somewhere in the Black Sea a thousand years ago. Uh, my memory is still inconsistent even though it's coming back a bit. I can't even ask if it's related to your condition because Sirion is in that state...'
Of course, Sirion was most exposed to chaos. Since the end of the war, he had been silent, sitting in a trance.
"Ozdok."
[Oh, my goodness!]
Ozdok jumped up in surprise.
He was startled because Sirion, who had been like a stone statue for a month, suddenly called him.
[Oh, Sir! Are you okay? You're awake!]
"Master!"
Ozdok quickly, and Luna and the knights slowly approached Sirion.
Sirion slowly rose and spread his energy towards them.
It was an aura mixed with the aura of creation and magical power. His aura shook off the chaos that had clung to the bodies of his daughter and the knights in an instant.
The erosion was not resolved. However, the expedition was able to lift their bodies as if they could survive with that alone.
"Are you always so surprised?"
[I'll be careful not to show any disrespect! I was just so moved that you finally woke up and... ]
Sirion gave a faint smile at his words.
Not only Ozdok but also the knights could not help but be shocked by his appearance.
On the contrary, Sirion's condition was better than before he was eroded by Kiar's chaos. Everyone felt that his aura had become purer.
"From today, bring the food made from the remnants of chaos only to me. I will purify it into energy and distribute it again."
[Yes, sir! I will do as you say, Sir!]
While Ozdok was almost jumping around collecting the knights' food, Sirion held up Barisada, looking at Inse.
It was to honor Lon, who ultimately blocked Gliac in Inse and fell in battle.
And suddenly, curiosity and faith towards his youngest son arose.

'Looking at the aura still faintly remaining from Lon... I wonder what help the youngest has given to his last enlightenment. In the end, it is sure that he will be the one to restore the family to its place.'
Luna, who had regained her energy, also raised her magic power and naturally helped Sirion's aura. She too was thinking the same as Sirion.
